name: app-ui-polish
summary: Rework the desktop UI to the Codex-minimal baseline
body:
The scaffold CSS was function-first and looked it. Now per design/09:
a draggable titlebar hosts the traffic lights, project name and a
branch pill (they used to overlap the pane titles); hue-derived
project avatars with an active indicator; change cards with identity
chips, muted shas and unresolved-comment pills; a segmented
side-by-side/unified control; kind-colored hunk pills with aligned
+N/-N stats; threaded comments grouped under their parents (same-
second timestamps used to invert reply order) with ghost/primary
buttons; custom-styled selects in a slim statusbar. All color goes
through the token layer — the no-hex-outside-tokens test caught two
violations and a new --on-accent token resolves them.
